title: 🤨 Pooja's SUM is twelve thousand short... the text cells nobody sees #excel #sum
title_alts: 🔍 Pooja checks COUNT against COUNTA... the three text cells it finds #excel #count
😬 Pooja converts a whole column... the ID code that loses its zero #excel #leadingzeros
description_hook: The calculator and the spreadsheet disagree about the same twelve rows, and nothing on screen is flagged. Every figure is visible; three of them are not numbers.

claims.claim: short by more than twelve thousand rupees
claims.basis: round illustrative shortfall in the example workbook, introduced as one sheet's story

claims.claim: Fifty-three thousand five hundred, every single time
claims.basis: round illustrative hand total for the example expense column

claims.claim: The spreadsheet insists on forty-one thousand
claims.basis: round illustrative figure chosen so the gap equals the three text cells
illustrative row count for the example expense column

claims.claim: Nine of the twelve really are numbers
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated setup: twelve rows less three text cells leaves nine numbers

claims.claim: Type four thousand two hundred yourself
claims.basis: illustrative single amount used to contrast a typed value with a pasted one
the same illustrative amount already stated, restated as what is displayed

claims.claim: the character numbered one hundred and sixty
claims.basis: the non-breaking space sits at character 160 in the code page Excel's CHAR function addresses

claims.claim: COUNT returns nine. COUNTA returns twelve. The gap is exactly three cells
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated setup: COUNTA counts twelve non-empty cells, COUNT counts the nine numeric ones

claims.claim: It should return twelve now, matching COUNTA exactly
claims.basis: once the three text cells convert, all twelve cells in the stated range are numeric

claims.claim: Fifty-three thousand five hundred, on the screen
claims.basis: the illustrative hand total already stated, now reached because no cell is skipped

claims.claim: The difference was twelve thousand five hundred
claims.basis: arithmetic on figures already stated: fifty-three thousand five hundred minus forty-one thousand

claims.claim: four thousand two hundred, three thousand eight hundred, four thousand five hundred
claims.basis: illustrative split chosen so the three cells sum to the stated gap of twelve thousand five hundred

claims.claim: One code reads zero zero seven four two. Two of its characters are zeros
claims.basis: illustrative employee code chosen to show leading zeros, presented as an example

claims.claim: Excel stores seven hundred and forty-two instead
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated code: a numeric reading of 00742 drops both leading zeros

claims.claim: Excel keeps fifteen significant digits, no more
claims.basis: the documented precision limit for a number stored in a cell

claims.claim: A sixteen-digit account number quietly loses its final digit to a zero
claims.basis: follows from the fifteen significant digit limit applied to a sixteen digit entry

claims.claim: A label like three point ten becomes three point one
claims.basis: a numeric reading drops a trailing zero after the decimal point

claims.claim: That repairs three cells and silently wrecks a whole column of codes
claims.basis: restates the three text amounts already counted in the example against the neighbouring code column

problem_domain: spreadsheet totals that silently exclude rows
setting: a small office's monthly expense workbook

characters.name: Pooja
characters.description: early thirties, dark hair in a low bun, mustard cardigan over a white kurta, reading glasses pushed up on her head

scenes.narration: Pooja's total is short by more than twelve thousand rupees. Nothing on screen says so.
scenes.caption: पूजा का कुल जोड़ 12,000 रुपये से ज़्यादा कम है, स्क्रीन पर कोई चेतावनी नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A paper ledger page open on a wooden desk, a long column of handwritten amounts ending in a total line circled twice in red pencil, warm lamp light falling from the left.

scenes.narration: She adds the same column again on a calculator. Fifty-three thousand five hundred, every single time.
scenes.caption: कैलकुलेटर पर वही कॉलम फिर जोड़ा तो हर बार 53,500 ही आया
scenes.image_brief: A desk calculator with a printed paper tape curling off the table edge onto the floor, the tape covered in a column of figures, bright morning window light.

scenes.narration: The spreadsheet insists on forty-one thousand. Same twelve rows. Same column, same file, same afternoon.
scenes.caption: शीट कहती है 41,000 — वही बारह पंक्तियाँ, वही कॉलम, वही फ़ाइल
scenes.image_brief: Two printed sheets lying side by side on a table, each one ending in a different total, one of the two figures boxed in blue ink, flat overhead daylight.

scenes.narration: No error message appears. No red cell, no scolding dialogue. Nothing looks broken.
scenes.caption: कोई एरर नहीं, कोई लाल सेल नहीं, कुछ भी टूटा हुआ नहीं दिखता
scenes.image_brief: Twelve small white cards pegged along a taut string line across a room, each card showing an amount in neat print, no marks or flags anywhere on them, soft even light.

scenes.narration: Every amount sits there in plain sight. Each one looks exactly like a number.
scenes.caption: हर रकम साफ़ दिख रही है और बिल्कुल नंबर जैसी लगती है
scenes.image_brief: A shallow tray of brass tokens stamped with numbers, all of them polished to the same shine and arranged in rows, bright tabletop light from above.

scenes.narration: Nine of the twelve really are numbers. Three of them only look like it.
scenes.caption: बारह में से नौ सच में नंबर हैं, तीन बस नंबर जैसे दिखते हैं
scenes.image_brief: The same tray of brass tokens, but three tokens are revealed as painted wooden copies, lighter in colour with visible grain, low side light raking across them.

scenes.narration: And one whole column must never be converted. Hold on to that one.
scenes.caption: और एक पूरे कॉलम को कभी बदलना नहीं चाहिए — यह बात याद रखें
scenes.image_brief: A narrow rack of wooden tokens standing apart from the brass trays, a small padlock closed across the rack's lid, low warm light pooling around it.

scenes.narration: SUM has exactly one rule. It adds numbers, and it steps over everything else.
scenes.caption: SUM का एक ही नियम है: नंबर जोड़ता है, बाक़ी सब छोड़ देता है
scenes.image_brief: A metal sorting chute above two bins, coins dropping cleanly into the near bin while flat paper squares slide past into a side tray, cool workshop light.

scenes.narration: Text inside the range is not an error to SUM. It is furniture, quietly ignored.
scenes.caption: रेंज में टेक्स्ट SUM के लिए एरर नहीं, बस फ़र्नीचर है जिसे वह छोड़ देता है
scenes.image_brief: A wooden crate of numbered blocks with a folded paper napkin wedged upright between two of them, the crate's counting lever passing straight over the napkin, dusty attic light.

scenes.narration: So the real question gets narrower. Why would a digit not be a number?
scenes.caption: तो असली सवाल और छोटा हो जाता है: एक अंक नंबर क्यों नहीं होता?
scenes.image_brief: A magnifying glass lying flat on a printed figure so the digits underneath swell and blur at the edges, daylight coming through a nearby window.

scenes.narration: Every cell stores two separate things. A value, and the kind of thing that value is.
scenes.caption: हर सेल दो अलग चीज़ें रखता है — वैल्यू, और वह किस तरह की चीज़ है
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard box on a shelf with two labels stapled to its side, the upper label listing the contents and the lower label naming the kind of contents, plain shelf light.

scenes.narration: Type four thousand two hundred yourself. Excel files it away as a quantity.
scenes.caption: आप ख़ुद 4200 टाइप करें तो एक्सेल उसे मात्रा की तरह रखता है
scenes.image_brief: The figure 4200 pressed deep into a slab of wet clay on a workbench, the impression solid and shadowed, a shaped stylus resting alongside, workbench lamp light.

scenes.narration: Paste the same digits out of a download. Excel may file them as a label.
scenes.caption: वही अंक किसी डाउनलोड से पेस्ट करें तो एक्सेल उन्हें लेबल बना सकता है
scenes.image_brief: A thin paper sticker printed 4200 peeling away at one corner from a smooth grey metal plate, cold storeroom light from a high window.

scenes.narration: The label reads 4200 on screen. It can be shown, sorted, printed. Never added.
scenes.caption: लेबल स्क्रीन पर 4200 दिखाता है — दिख सकता है, जुड़ नहीं सकता
scenes.image_brief: A shop price tag hanging from a string above a brass balance pan, the tag resting on the pan without tipping it at all, showroom light.

scenes.narration: Where does a label like that come from? Almost always from somewhere outside your file.
scenes.caption: ऐसा लेबल कहाँ से आता है? लगभग हमेशा आपकी फ़ाइल के बाहर से
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard carton standing on a doorstep with a courier label and a foreign postmark across it, early morning light stretching a long shadow across the tiles.

scenes.narration: A statement download. A report from the billing software. A table copied off a web page.
scenes.caption: बैंक स्टेटमेंट, बिलिंग सॉफ़्टवेयर की रिपोर्ट, या वेब से कॉपी की गई टेबल
scenes.image_brief: Three different documents fanned out across a desk: a bank statement, a machine-printed software report, and a page torn from a magazine table, even daylight over all three.

scenes.narration: Those files carry passengers. A trailing space, a stray comma, a hidden non-breaking space.
scenes.caption: उन फ़ाइलों में यात्री छिपे होते हैं: स्पेस, भटका कॉमा, या नॉन-ब्रेकिंग स्पेस
scenes.image_brief: A single printed line of figures on cream paper with tiny stowaway marks between the digits, a comma, a blank gap and a faint dot, raking light across the page texture.

scenes.narration: One stray character is enough. The whole cell turns into text, silently.
scenes.caption: एक भटका हुआ अक्षर काफ़ी है — पूरा सेल चुपचाप टेक्स्ट बन जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A single grain of sand jammed between the teeth of two small brass gears that have stopped turning, a workshop lamp burning close above them.

scenes.narration: Formatting a column as Text before pasting does exactly the same damage.
scenes.caption: पेस्ट से पहले कॉलम को टेक्स्ट फ़ॉर्मैट करना ठीक वही नुक़सान करता है
scenes.image_brief: A rubber stamp reading TEXT pressed across the head of a fresh column of printed figures, wet ink bleeding into the paper fibres, plain office light.

scenes.narration: Now the chain closes. Text cell, skipped cell, short total, wrong decision made downstream.
scenes.caption: अब कड़ी पूरी हुई: टेक्स्ट सेल, छूटा सेल, कम कुल, और आगे ग़लत फ़ैसला
scenes.image_brief: Four paper links hanging in a chain from a nail in a wall, each link printed with one word, TEXT, SKIPPED, SHORT, DECISION, dim hallway light.

scenes.narration: AVERAGE skips it too. So does SUMIF. So does every point on your chart.
scenes.caption: AVERAGE भी छोड़ता है, SUMIF भी, और चार्ट का हर पॉइंट भी
scenes.image_brief: Four small bench machines in a row, each with an empty output tray beneath it, one a totting machine, one an averaging dial, one a filter box, one a plotting arm, cold bench light.

scenes.narration: Before touching a single cell, save a second copy of the whole file.
scenes.caption: एक भी सेल छूने से पहले पूरी फ़ाइल की दूसरी कॉपी सेव कर लें
scenes.image_brief: Two identical card folders lying on a desk, one labelled ORIGINAL and one labelled COPY, a glass paperweight holding the first one down, warm desk light.

scenes.narration: Conversion cannot always be undone by eye. A lost leading zero looks perfectly fine.
scenes.caption: बदलाव आँख से हमेशा वापस नहीं होता — खोया हुआ शुरुआती ज़ीरो ठीक लगता है
scenes.image_brief: A brass number plate stamped 00742 lying beside a second plate stamped 742, the pair almost matching until compared, hard side light across the metal.

scenes.narration: Next, get one independent total from outside the spreadsheet entirely.
scenes.caption: अगला कदम: शीट के बाहर से एक अलग कुल आँकड़ा हासिल करें
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator resting on top of a folded bank statement on a kitchen table, a cup of tea beside it, low evening light through a curtain.

scenes.narration: A calculator, the bank statement, last month's signed figure. Anything you did not compute here.
scenes.caption: कैलकुलेटर, बैंक स्टेटमेंट, पिछले महीने का साइन किया आँकड़ा — कोई भी चलेगा
scenes.image_brief: Three sources of one figure laid out on a cloth: a calculator with its display lit, a stamped bank slip, and a signed page from last month, even light on all three.

scenes.narration: Without that number you cannot tell a repair from a fresh mistake.
scenes.caption: उस आँकड़े के बिना मरम्मत और नई ग़लती में फ़र्क़ पता नहीं चलेगा
scenes.image_brief: A pair of balance scales on a market stall counter, one pan holding a single iron weight and the other pan completely empty and tipped high, dusty stall light.

scenes.narration: Now list the columns that hold quantities. Amount, quantity, hours, units, rate.
scenes.caption: अब वे कॉलम गिनें जिनमें मात्रा है: रकम, संख्या, घंटे, यूनिट, दर
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard in a small meeting room with a hand-drawn table, the left column headed QUANTITIES and listing amount, hours and units, flat fluorescent light.

scenes.narration: Then list the columns that hold labels. Invoice number, employee code, pin code.
scenes.caption: फिर वे कॉलम जिनमें लेबल हैं: इनवॉइस नंबर, कर्मचारी कोड, पिन कोड
scenes.image_brief: The same whiteboard with a second column now filled in under the heading LABELS, listing invoice number, employee code and pin code, a marker capped on the tray, fluorescent light.

scenes.narration: Labels stay text, permanently. Nobody has ever needed to total invoice numbers.
scenes.caption: लेबल हमेशा टेक्स्ट रहते हैं — इनवॉइस नंबर जोड़ने की ज़रूरत किसी को नहीं पड़ी
scenes.image_brief: An open metal filing drawer packed with index cards, each card carrying a printed code along its top edge, no totals anywhere on them, still archive room light.

scenes.narration: Finally, switch on the status bar along the bottom edge of the window.
scenes.caption: आख़िर में, विंडो के नीचे वाला स्टेटस बार चालू कर लें
scenes.image_brief: A long brass strip fixed along the bottom rail of a wooden display frame, engraved with the words Sum, Average and Count, workshop light glancing off the metal.

scenes.narration: Start with alignment. Click nothing, change nothing, just look at the cell edges.
scenes.caption: शुरुआत अलाइनमेंट से — कुछ क्लिक न करें, बस सेल के किनारे देखें
scenes.image_brief: A shelf of open-fronted wooden boxes in a row, the single block inside each box pushed hard against one side wall, quiet storeroom light.

scenes.narration: A real number hugs the right edge of its cell. Text hugs the left.
scenes.caption: असली नंबर सेल के दाएँ किनारे से चिपकता है, टेक्स्ट बाएँ से
scenes.image_brief: Two identical open boxes standing next to each other, the block in one pressed to the right wall and the block in the other pressed to the left wall, bright even light.

scenes.narration: Three of Pooja's amounts sit left. That is the first clue, and it is free.
scenes.caption: पूजा की तीन रकमें बाएँ बैठी हैं — यही पहला और मुफ़्त सुराग़ है
scenes.image_brief: Twelve open boxes in a long line, nine blocks leaning to the right walls and three unmistakably against the left walls, overhead daylight flattening the shadows.

scenes.narration: Now select the whole amount column, with one click on its letter header.
scenes.caption: अब हेडर के अक्षर पर एक क्लिक से रकम का पूरा कॉलम चुनें
scenes.image_brief: A single tall wooden column drawn out from a rack of stored columns, held upright and whole, sawdust in the air of a workshop, warm work light.

scenes.narration: The status bar reports Sum, Average and Count for whatever you have selected.
scenes.caption: स्टेटस बार चुने हुए हिस्से का Sum, Average और Count बताता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A brass instrument panel with three small glass windows, each window showing a printed figure under an engraved word, steady lamp light on the dial faces.

scenes.narration: Put two formulas in spare cells. COUNT of that range, then COUNTA of it.
scenes.caption: दो ख़ाली सेल में फ़ॉर्मूला डालें: उस रेंज का COUNT, फिर COUNTA
scenes.image_brief: Two empty pigeonholes at the end of a wooden letter rack, each with a fresh blank paper label slotted into its brass holder, soft side light.

scenes.narration: COUNT counts numbers only. COUNTA counts every cell that is not empty.
scenes.caption: COUNT सिर्फ़ नंबर गिनता है, COUNTA हर भरा हुआ सेल गिनता है
scenes.image_brief: Two sieves resting over two bowls on a kitchen counter, the first sieve holding back paper squares while the second lets everything through, window light from the side.

scenes.narration: COUNT returns nine. COUNTA returns twelve. The gap is exactly three cells.
scenes.caption: COUNT देता है नौ, COUNTA देता है बारह — अंतर ठीक तीन सेल का
scenes.image_brief: Two mechanical tally counters bolted to a board, one showing 9 and the other showing 12, a chalked figure 3 scrawled between them, plain workshop light.

scenes.narration: Three suspects, counted without opening a single one. Now go and name them.
scenes.caption: तीन संदिग्ध, बिना कोई सेल खोले गिन लिए — अब उन्हें पहचानें
scenes.image_brief: Three empty chairs pulled up to a long polished table, a folded name card lying face down at each of the three places, cool hall light from high windows.

scenes.narration: In a helper column beside the data, type ISTEXT of the first amount.
scenes.caption: डेटा के बग़ल में एक हेल्पर कॉलम में पहली रकम का ISTEXT लिखें
scenes.image_brief: A rubber stamp reading TRUE held poised just above the first row of a printed list, an ink pad open beside it, focused desk light.

scenes.narration: Fill it down the column. Every TRUE is a number that is not one.
scenes.caption: कॉलम में नीचे तक भरें — हर TRUE वह नंबर है जो नंबर नहीं है
scenes.image_brief: A printed page with a column of TRUE and FALSE words running down beside a column of amounts, three of the TRUEs marked with pencil ticks, daylight on the paper.

scenes.narration: Read the heading above that column before you fix anything. Amount, or account number?
scenes.caption: कुछ भी ठीक करने से पहले उस कॉलम का हेडिंग पढ़ें: रकम, या अकाउंट नंबर?
scenes.image_brief: A stiff card held upright on a desk stand, the word AMOUNT printed on the face and ACCOUNT NUMBER showing faintly through from the reverse, plain flat light.

scenes.narration: Amounts get converted. Labels do not. Keep that distinction for the moment.
scenes.caption: रकमें बदली जाती हैं, लेबल नहीं — यह फ़र्क़ आगे के लिए याद रखें
scenes.image_brief: Two shallow sorting trays side by side on a bench, one stencilled CONVERT and the other stencilled LEAVE, a few paper slips already in each, light falling from above.

scenes.narration: Conversion often fails on the first attempt, because the text underneath is dirty.
scenes.caption: पहली कोशिश में बदलाव अक्सर फ़ेल होता है, क्योंकि नीचे का टेक्स्ट गंदा है
scenes.image_brief: A brass key stopped halfway into a door lock clogged with grit and paint flakes, a hand still on the key, flat daylight on a front door.

scenes.narration: So clean first. Wrap the cell in TRIM inside a second helper column.
scenes.caption: तो पहले सफ़ाई: दूसरे हेल्पर कॉलम में सेल को TRIM में लपेटें
scenes.image_brief: A stiff-bristled brush sweeping fine dust off both ends of a long printed paper strip pinned to a workbench, angled bench light picking out the dust.

scenes.narration: TRIM strips the leading spaces, the trailing spaces, and doubled spaces inside the text.
scenes.caption: TRIM आगे-पीछे के स्पेस और बीच के दोहरे स्पेस हटा देता है
scenes.image_brief: A long paper strip pinned flat on a craft table, scissors snipping the blank ends away while the gaps in the middle close up, bright craft lamp light.

scenes.narration: Some cells resist TRIM completely. Those ones hold a non-breaking space instead.
scenes.caption: कुछ सेल TRIM से बिल्कुल नहीं मानते — उनमें नॉन-ब्रेकिंग स्पेस होता है
scenes.image_brief: A wire brush lifted away from a paper strip it has swept clean except for one pale mark that remains stuck fast to the paper, hard bench light from one side.

scenes.narration: It looks identical to an ordinary space, and behaves nothing at all like one.
scenes.caption: वह आम स्पेस जैसा ही दिखता है और चलता बिल्कुल उसके जैसा नहीं
scenes.image_brief: Two identical white pebbles resting on dark cloth, one rolling freely and the other held immovable by a magnet hidden under the fabric, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Substitute it out, using the character numbered one hundred and sixty.
scenes.caption: उसे SUBSTITUTE से हटाएँ, अक्षर संख्या एक सौ साठ का इस्तेमाल करके
scenes.image_brief: Fine tweezers lifting a transparent chip out of a printed row of digits, a small brass tag stamped 160 lying on the bench beside it, bench lamp light.

scenes.narration: Tables copied from web pages are full of them. Downloaded reports too.
scenes.caption: वेब पेज से कॉपी की टेबल में ये भरे होते हैं, डाउनलोड रिपोर्ट में भी
scenes.image_brief: A printed web page and a machine-printed report pinned side by side on a corkboard, both speckled with faint transparent flecks across the figures, plain office light.

scenes.narration: Now convert. The fastest route is the small green triangle in a cell corner.
scenes.caption: अब बदलें — सबसे तेज़ रास्ता है सेल के कोने का छोटा हरा त्रिकोण
scenes.image_brief: A small green enamel triangle badge pinned to the top corner of a plain paper card standing on a desk, sharp desk light catching its edge.

scenes.narration: Select every flagged cell, open that warning menu, and choose Convert to Number.
scenes.caption: हर फ़्लैग वाला सेल चुनें, चेतावनी मेनू खोलें, Convert to Number चुनें
scenes.image_brief: A hinged flap on the corner of a cardboard box lifted open to reveal a short printed list of choices inside the lid, steady desk light.

scenes.narration: Watch the alignment jump right. That jump is your confirmation, not the total.
scenes.caption: अलाइनमेंट को दाईं तरफ़ छलकते देखें — वही छलाँग पुष्टि है, कुल नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A wooden block caught mid-slide across the floor of its open box, from the left wall towards the right, fine dust trailing behind it, clear bright light.

scenes.narration: No triangle appearing anywhere? Then use Text to Columns instead. It never fails.
scenes.caption: कहीं त्रिकोण नहीं दिख रहा? तब Text to Columns इस्तेमाल करें, यह कभी फ़ेल नहीं होता
scenes.image_brief: The bare corner of a paper card where a badge should sit, and behind it a whole pinned sheet of cards carrying no flags at all, flat overcast light.

scenes.narration: Select one single column, on its own. Data tab, then Text to Columns.
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ एक कॉलम चुनें, अकेला। Data टैब, फिर Text to Columns
scenes.image_brief: One wooden column lifted clear of a leaning stack and laid alone across two sawhorses in a workshop, the stack out of the way behind, warm work light.

scenes.narration: Choose Delimited. Click Next, click Next again, and set the format to General.
scenes.caption: Delimited चुनें। Next, फिर Next, और फ़ॉर्मैट General पर सेट करें
scenes.image_brief: A metal sorting frame with three sliding levers pushed along in sequence and a final round dial turned to a setting engraved GENERAL, hard factory light.

scenes.narration: Finish. Excel re-reads every cell as though you had just typed it yourself.
scenes.caption: Finish दबाएँ। एक्सेल हर सेल को ऐसे पढ़ता है जैसे आपने अभी टाइप किया हो
scenes.image_brief: A conveyor belt carrying printed cards back into the mouth of a reading machine, each card entering from its first character again, cold plant light.

scenes.narration: That is precisely why it works. The same characters, a completely fresh reading.
scenes.caption: यही वजह है कि यह काम करता है — वही अक्षर, पूरी तरह नई समझ
scenes.image_brief: A typewriter retyping a column of figures onto crisp fresh paper while the old creased sheet lies pushed aside on the desk, close study lamp light.

scenes.narration: For cells scattered across several columns, multiply the whole lot by one.
scenes.caption: कई कॉलमों में बिखरे सेल के लिए, पूरे ढेर को एक से गुणा कर दें
scenes.image_brief: Paper cards scattered unevenly across a wide pegboard in several loose columns, each card marked with a small pencil cross, broad hall light.

scenes.narration: Type the number one into any empty cell, then copy that cell.
scenes.caption: किसी भी ख़ाली सेल में एक लिखें, फिर उस सेल को कॉपी करें
scenes.image_brief: A single small card printed with the numeral one lying alone at the centre of a dark table, a narrow beam of light falling only on the card.

scenes.narration: Select your whole range. Paste Special, tick Multiply, then press OK.
scenes.caption: अपनी पूरी रेंज चुनें। Paste Special, Multiply पर टिक, फिर OK
scenes.image_brief: A hand-crank multiplying machine clamped to a bench, a paper card feeding into one side and a freshly stamped figure emerging from the other, warm workshop light.

scenes.narration: Arithmetic forces a decision, and Excel always decides in favour of the number.
scenes.caption: गणित फ़ैसला करवाता है, और एक्सेल हमेशा नंबर के पक्ष में फ़ैसला करता है
scenes.image_brief: Two painted paths on a warehouse floor converging at a single steel gate stencilled ARITHMETIC, one path open through it and the other barred, high bay light.

scenes.narration: Safest of all is a VALUE formula, then paste the results back as values.
scenes.caption: सबसे सुरक्षित है VALUE फ़ॉर्मूला, फिर नतीजे वैल्यू बनाकर वापस पेस्ट करना
scenes.image_brief: A growing column of fresh paper slips laid out beside an untouched original page on a quiet desk, both held down by smooth river stones, soft desk light.

scenes.narration: Re-run COUNT. It should return twelve now, matching COUNTA exactly.
scenes.caption: COUNT फिर चलाएँ — अब बारह आना चाहिए, ठीक COUNTA जितना
scenes.image_brief: Two mechanical tally counters mounted side by side on a wooden board, both dials now reading 12, even workshop light across the brass faces.

scenes.narration: That equality is the real test. Not the total. The count.
scenes.caption: यही बराबरी असली जाँच है — कुल नहीं, गिनती
scenes.image_brief: A slate propped against a wall with a single chalk equals sign drawn between two painted counter dials, dust on the slate ledge, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: Now read the total again. Fifty-three thousand five hundred, on the screen.
scenes.caption: अब कुल फिर पढ़ें — स्क्रीन पर 53,500
scenes.image_brief: A ledger page with a freshly inked total written on the ruled line at the foot of a long column, the nib still resting beside it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: It matches the calculator tape, rupee for rupee. Nothing was rounded away.
scenes.caption: कैलकुलेटर की पर्ची से एक-एक रुपये तक मेल खाता है, कुछ गोल नहीं हुआ
scenes.image_brief: A printed calculator tape and a ledger page laid edge to edge on a desk so their two final figures sit immediately next to each other, steady desk light.

scenes.narration: The difference was twelve thousand five hundred, and it was never a mystery.
scenes.caption: फ़र्क़ पूरे 12,500 रुपये का था, और यह कोई रहस्य नहीं था
scenes.image_brief: Balance scales on a market counter with three small paper slips in one pan exactly balancing a single larger slip in the other, dusty stall light.

scenes.narration: Three cells held it: four thousand two hundred, three thousand eight hundred, four thousand five hundred.
scenes.caption: यह तीन सेल में था: 4,200, 3,800 और 4,500
scenes.image_brief: Three stiff cards laid in a row on a bare table, each hand-written with one large amount in thick marker, flat daylight from a window above.

scenes.narration: Add those three together and you get the gap precisely. No coincidence there.
scenes.caption: इन तीन को जोड़ें तो ठीक वही अंतर मिलता है — यह संयोग नहीं है
scenes.image_brief: A pencil addition worked out in the wide margin of a printed page, three figures stacked above a ruled line with their sum below, close desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Those figures are illustrative, of course. The arithmetic behind them is the real point.
scenes.caption: ये आँकड़े उदाहरण के लिए हैं, पर उनके पीछे का गणित ही असली बात है
scenes.image_brief: A small card stamped ILLUSTRATIVE resting on the corner of a worked example page held down by a paperclip, plain flat light on the paper.

scenes.narration: Sort the column next. Numbers sort by size, and text sorts alphabetically.
scenes.caption: अब कॉलम को सॉर्ट करें — नंबर आकार से, और टेक्स्ट अक्षर क्रम से
scenes.image_brief: Numbered wooden tiles dropping one by one through a narrow sorting slot into a graded rack, the heaviest tiles settling at the far end, table light.

scenes.narration: If a hundred lands above ninety, something in that column is still text.
scenes.caption: अगर सौ नब्बे के ऊपर बैठा है, तो उस कॉलम में कुछ अभी भी टेक्स्ट है
scenes.image_brief: Two shelves of numbered tiles in a shop, the upper shelf arranged by size and the lower one alphabetically so a hundred sits above a ninety, store light.

scenes.narration: Last check: delete the helper columns, save, and confirm the total has not moved.
scenes.caption: आख़िरी जाँच: हेल्पर कॉलम हटाएँ, सेव करें, और देखें कुल नहीं बदला
scenes.image_brief: Loose helper pages being drawn out of a card folder while the remaining page keeps its unchanged total at the foot, quiet evening desk light.

scenes.narration: Now the column you must never convert. It was waiting all along.
scenes.caption: अब वह कॉलम जिसे कभी बदलना नहीं चाहिए — वह शुरू से इंतज़ार कर रहा था
scenes.image_brief: A whole column of paper cards standing face down inside a locked glass case on a wooden plinth in an otherwise empty room, cool museum light from above.

scenes.narration: Beside Pooja's amounts sits a column of employee codes. Those are text too.
scenes.caption: पूजा की रकमों के बग़ल में कर्मचारी कोड का कॉलम है — वे भी टेक्स्ट हैं
scenes.image_brief: A row of stamped metal employee badges hanging on a rail above a tray of loose currency notes on a locker room bench, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: One code reads zero zero seven four two. Two of its characters are zeros.
scenes.caption: एक कोड ऐसा पढ़ा जाता है: ज़ीरो ज़ीरो सात चार दो
scenes.image_brief: A punched metal tag stamped 00742 hanging from a hook on a workshop board among empty hooks, angled work light on the stamped grooves.

scenes.narration: Convert it and Excel stores seven hundred and forty-two instead.
scenes.caption: उसे बदल दें तो एक्सेल उसकी जगह सात सौ बयालीस रख लेता है
scenes.image_brief: The same metal tag lying on an anvil, re-stamped to read 742 with the two leading zeros hammered flat into the surface, hard bench light.

scenes.narration: Both zeros are gone, with no warning. Payroll now points at a stranger.
scenes.caption: दोनों ज़ीरो ग़ायब, कोई चेतावनी नहीं — पेरोल अब किसी अजनबी पर लगा है
scenes.image_brief: A payroll envelope on an office desk with an unfamiliar name showing through its address window, a tray of other envelopes behind it, plain office light.

scenes.narration: The same trap arrives with long digits. Excel keeps fifteen significant digits, no more.
scenes.caption: वही जाल लंबे अंकों के साथ आता है: एक्सेल पंद्रह सार्थक अंक ही रखता है
scenes.image_brief: A long paper strip printed with a run of sixteen digits stretched across a table, the final digit fading into blank paper, even daylight along the strip.

scenes.narration: A sixteen-digit account number quietly loses its final digit to a zero.
scenes.caption: सोलह अंकों का अकाउंट नंबर चुपचाप अपना आख़िरी अंक ज़ीरो कर देता है
scenes.image_brief: A card-sized metal plate on a bank counter with its last digit position replaced by an empty blank slot, a rubber stamp lying beside it, counter light.

scenes.narration: A label like three point ten becomes three point one. Some codes become dates.
scenes.caption: 3.10 जैसा लेबल 3.1 बन जाता है, और कुछ कोड तारीख़ बन जाते हैं
scenes.image_brief: Three parcel labels lined up on a sorting bench, one reading 3.10, the next reading 3.1, the third printed as a calendar date, bright sorting room light.

scenes.narration: So the rule is short. If you never do arithmetic on it, leave it text.
scenes.caption: नियम छोटा है: जिस पर गणित नहीं करते, उसे टेक्स्ट ही रहने दें
scenes.image_brief: A wooden signboard at a fork in a country road, one arm painted DO ARITHMETIC and the other LEAVE AS TEXT, wide open afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Identifiers are text on purpose. That is not a defect waiting for your repair.
scenes.caption: पहचान कोड जान-बूझकर टेक्स्ट होते हैं — यह सुधारने वाली ख़राबी नहीं है
scenes.image_brief: A rack of luggage tags hanging at a railway parcel office, each tag carrying a printed code and not one carrying a price, dim station light.

scenes.narration: The common mistake? Selecting the whole sheet and converting everything in one sweep.
scenes.caption: आम ग़लती? पूरी शीट चुनकर सब कुछ एक ही झटके में बदल देना
scenes.image_brief: A broad felt marker dragged in one long stroke right across an entire printed sheet of ruled cells on a desk, ink still glistening, sharp desk light.

scenes.narration: That repairs three cells and silently wrecks a whole column of codes. Worse than before.
scenes.caption: वह तीन सेल सुधारता है और चुपचाप कोड का पूरा कॉलम बरबाद कर देता है
scenes.image_brief: Three carefully mended cups standing on a shelf with a long row of shattered code tags scattered on the shelf below them, even light across both shelves.

scenes.narration: One more limit. A cleaned sheet stays clean only until the next export lands.
scenes.caption: एक और सीमा: साफ़ की हुई शीट अगले एक्सपोर्ट तक ही साफ़ रहती है
scenes.image_brief: A swept and empty workbench with an unopened wooden crate stencilled NEXT MONTH standing right beside it, plain storeroom light.

scenes.narration: If the file arrives monthly, set the column types during the import instead.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल हर महीने आती है? तो इंपोर्ट के वक़्त ही कॉलम टाइप सेट करें
scenes.image_brief: An intake desk where each column of a form is marked with a type stamp before the papers are passed further along the counter, bright reception light.

scenes.narration: Try it now. Select one amount column and put COUNT beside COUNTA.
scenes.caption: अभी करके देखें: एक रकम कॉलम चुनें और COUNT के साथ COUNTA रखें
scenes.image_brief: An open workbook on a kitchen table with one column outlined in pencil and two fresh formulas written at its foot, morning light across the page.

scenes.narration: If they disagree, your total was never wrong. It was answering a smaller question.
scenes.caption: अगर दोनों अलग हैं, तो कुल ग़लत नहीं था — वह छोटे सवाल का जवाब दे रहा था
scenes.image_brief: A ledger page with its inked total on the bottom line and a single pencilled question mark added in the margin beside it, low lamp light.
